## Quality Management System Overview

### Purpose

This Quality Management Review (QMR) template provides a structured framework for evaluating the effectiveness and performance of the pharmaceutical quality system in accordance with ICH Q10, FDA Quality Systems Approach to Pharmaceutical cGMP Regulations, EU GMP Chapter 1, and ISO 13485:2016 (for medical devices). Regular quality management reviews are a regulatory requirement and a critical element of continuous improvement.

### Scope

This review encompasses all GxP-regulated operations, including:
- Manufacturing processes
- Laboratory operations
- Quality systems and procedures
- Regulatory compliance activities
- Supply chain management
- Product lifecycle management

### Regulatory Framework

This quality management review fulfills requirements in:

- **FDA Requirements**:
  - 21 CFR 211.22 - Responsibilities of quality control unit
  - 21 CFR 211.180(e) - Requirements for management review of records and data
  - 21 CFR 820.20(c) - Management review (for medical devices)

- **EU GMP Requirements**:
  - EU GMP Chapter 1 - Pharmaceutical Quality System
  - EU GMP Annex 15 - Qualification and Validation

- **ICH Guidelines**:
  - ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System
  - ICH Q9 - Quality Risk Management

- **ISO Standards**:
  - ISO 13485:2016 Section 5.6 - Management Review (for medical devices)
  - ISO 9001:2015 Section 9.3 - Management Review (where applicable)

### Review Periodicity

- Comprehensive reviews: Quarterly
- Annual management review: End of fiscal year
- Ad-hoc reviews: As needed for significant quality events

## Review Schedule and Participants

### Scheduling Guidance

| Review Type | Frequency | Timing | Duration |
|-------------|-----------|--------|----------|
| Executive Quality Review | Quarterly | Within 30 days of quarter end | 2-3 hours |
| Department-Level Reviews | Monthly | Within 15 days of month end | 1-2 hours |
| Annual Management Review | Yearly | Within 60 days of fiscal year end | Full day |

### Required Participants

| Role | Responsibility in Review | Materials to Prepare |
|------|--------------------------|----------------------|
| Quality Management Representative | Facilitate meeting, present quality metrics | Overall quality metrics package, trends analysis |
| Site Head/General Manager | Review resource allocation, strategic direction | Business impact assessment |
| Head of Quality Assurance | Present audit findings, compliance status | Audit metrics, regulatory inspection summary |
| Head of Quality Control | Present laboratory performance metrics | Testing metrics, OOS/OOT trends |
| Head of Manufacturing | Present production quality metrics | Manufacturing performance, deviation trends |
| Head of Engineering/Maintenance | Present facility/equipment status | Facility and equipment metrics |
| Head of Regulatory Affairs | Present regulatory compliance status | Regulatory submission status, commitments tracking |
| Supply Chain Representative | Present supplier quality metrics | Supplier qualification status, performance metrics |

### Optional Participants (Based on Agenda)

- Validation Manager
- IT/Computer Systems Manager
- Training Manager
- R&D Representative
- External Subject Matter Experts

#### KPI Analysis and Insights

[Provide analysis of key trends, emerging patterns, areas of excellence, and concerns requiring attention. Include root causes for metrics not meeting targets and cross-functional impacts.]

#### Example:

**Manufacturing Quality KPIs**

| KPI | Target | Current Period | Previous Period | Trend | Status |
|-----|--------|----------------|----------------|-------|--------|
| Right First Time (RFT) | ≥95% | 93.2% | 91.8% | ↑ | Yellow |
| Batch Rejection Rate | ≤1% | 0.8% | 1.2% | ↑ | Green |
| Deviation Rate per Batch | ≤1.5 | 1.8 | 2.1 | ↑ | Yellow |

**Analysis:** Manufacturing KPIs show improving trends but RFT remains below target due to ongoing challenges in the sterile filling area. The investigation revealed that 65% of failures were related to environmental monitoring excursions following recent HVAC modifications. An engineering assessment has been completed and corrective actions are in implementation phase. Batch rejection rate has improved significantly due to enhanced pre-review process and operator training program implemented in Q1.

### Meeting Minutes Template Example:

**Quality Management Review - Q2 2025**

**Date:** July 15, 2025  
**Time:** 09:00 - 12:30  
**Location:** Board Room and Teams Meeting  
**Chair:** J. Smith, Head of Quality  
**Minute Taker:** A. Johnson, Quality Systems Specialist

**Attendees:**
- J. Smith, Head of Quality
- R. Williams, Site Director
- M. Brown, Head of Manufacturing
- S. Davis, Head of QC
- T. Wilson, Regulatory Affairs
- L. Johnson, Validation Manager
- K. Martinez, Supply Chain Manager

**Key Discussion Points:**

1. **CAPA System Performance**
   - CAPA closure rate improved from 85% to 92% this quarter
   - Effectiveness check failure rate decreased from 12% to 8%
   - Recurring issue with documentation errors in Area B identified
   - Decision: Implement targeted documentation training for Area B personnel

2. **Audit Findings**
   - Successful FDA inspection with zero 483 observations
   - Internal audit program on track with 95% completion rate
   - Common findings related to equipment maintenance documentation
   - Decision: Conduct focused review of equipment maintenance procedures

3. **Resource Requirements**
   - QC department currently at 85% staffing with active recruitment
   - Impact on testing turnaround time evident but within acceptable limits
   - Budget for laboratory equipment upgrades approved
   - Decision: Expedite QC analyst hiring through external recruitment agency

## Quality Metrics Dashboard Integration

### Dashboard Implementation

| Dashboard Element | Data Source | Update Frequency | Owner | User Access |
|-------------------|-------------|------------------|-------|------------|
| Executive Summary | Quality KPIs | Weekly | Quality Systems | Senior Management |
| Manufacturing Metrics | MES/EBR System | Daily | Manufacturing | Production/Quality |
| Lab Testing Metrics | LIMS | Daily | QC | Laboratory/Quality |
| CAPA Metrics | Quality Management System | Weekly | Quality Assurance | All Quality Staff |
| Supplier Metrics | ERP/Supplier Management System | Monthly | Supply Chain | Procurement/Quality |

### Dashboard Visualization Guidelines

**Design Principles:**
- Use consistent color scheme (Green/Yellow/Red for status indicators)
- Implement trend indicators (↑/↓/→) for performance over time
- Include both tabular data and graphical representations
- Establish standard thresholds for all metrics
- Provide drill-down capabilities for root cause analysis

**Key Visualization Components:**
1. Trend Charts - Display performance over 12-month period
2. Control Charts - Show process stability and capability
3. Pareto Charts - Identify most significant quality issues
4. Heat Maps - Highlight problem areas across products/processes
5. Scorecard Summary - Present high-level status for executive review

### Data Collection and Integration

| Data Type | Collection Method | System Integration | Data Quality Checks | Frequency |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------|
| Manufacturing Data | Automated from MES | API Connection | Validation Rules | Real-time |
| Laboratory Data | Automated from LIMS | API Connection | Validation Rules | Daily |
| Deviation Data | Manual Entry/QMS | Database Query | Supervisory Review | Weekly |
| Audit Findings | Manual Entry | Database Query | QA Review | Per Audit |
| Customer Complaints | CRM System | API Connection | Investigation Verification | Weekly |

**Pharmaceutical Manufacturing:**
- Process Capability Indices (Cpk)

- Yield Consistency

**Biologics:**
- Cell Culture Performance
- Protein Yield
- Purification Efficiency
- Host Cell Protein Clearance
- Endotoxin Level Control

**Medical Devices:**
- Component Acceptance Rates
- Sterilization Validation Metrics
- Package Integrity Testing
- Device Functional Testing Results
- Material Compatibility Verification

### Dashboard Review Process

**Review Frequency:**
- Daily Operational Review: Process-level metrics
- Weekly Management Review: Department-level metrics
- Monthly Executive Review: Site-level summary metrics
- Quarterly Quality Management Review: Comprehensive metrics package

**Integration with Quality Management Review:**
- Pre-meeting distribution of dashboard summary (3 days prior)
- Focus on exceptions and negative trends during review
- Record of dashboard metrics included in meeting minutes
- Action items linked to specific metrics requiring improvement

## When to Use

Use throughout the project lifecycle to identify, assess, and track risks. This template is essential for projects with significant complexity, multiple stakeholders, or high business impact, where structured risk management provides decision-making value.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for very low-risk, short-duration tasks where informal risk awareness is sufficient. Avoid this template if your governance framework requires a different risk management approach or if stakeholders prefer real-time risk dashboards over static registers.

### Appendix B: Review Preparation Checklist

**Four Weeks Before Review:**
- [ ] Schedule meeting and notify participants
- [ ] Distribute data collection templates to functional areas
- [ ] Review previous management review minutes and action items
- [ ] Update quality metrics dashboard

**Two Weeks Before Review:**
- [ ] Collect and compile data from all functional areas
- [ ] Analyze trends and identify significant issues
- [ ] Prepare preliminary presentation materials
- [ ] Review draft with key stakeholders

**One Week Before Review:**
- [ ] Finalize presentation materials
- [ ] Distribute agenda and pre-read materials
- [ ] Confirm participant availability
- [ ] Prepare meeting logistics

**Post-Review Activities:**
- [ ] Distribute meeting minutes within 5 business days
- [ ] Enter action items into tracking system
- [ ] Schedule follow-up reviews for critical items
- [ ] Communicate key decisions to organization

### Appendix C: Quality Risk Assessment Methodology

**Risk Assessment Tools:**
- Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
- Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP)
- Hazard Operability Analysis (HAZOP)
- Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA)
- Risk Ranking and Filtering
- Fault Tree Analysis

**Risk Assessment Process:**
1. Risk Identification
2. Risk Analysis
3. Risk Evaluation
4. Risk Control
5. Risk Communication
6. Risk Review

**Risk Quantification:**
- Probability (P): 1-5 scale (1=Rare, 5=Almost Certain)
- Impact (I): 1-5 scale (1=Negligible, 5=Catastrophic)
- Detection (D): 1-5 scale (1=Certain Detection, 5=Cannot Detect)
- Risk Priority Number (RPN) = P × I × D
